title: Fractured Ballerina
description: A cracked porcelain-like ballerina stands en pointe in a decaying theater, her body fractured with golden seams and black fissures. Her red and gold tutu is torn while her arms are raised in a broken ballet pose, surrounded by floating empty picture frames, dripping paint, and a collapsing wooden floor revealing an underwater city beneath.
prompt: A surreal scene of a ballerina whose body is made of cracked porcelain with visible black fissures and golden repair lines, standing en pointe in a decaying ornate theater. Her red and gold tutu is torn and dripping, arms raised in a graceful yet broken pose. Empty gilded picture frames float around her, paint drips down the walls, and the wooden floor is breaking apart to reveal an underwater city with buildings and boats below. Dramatic purple and yellow light beams cut through the dusty air, cinematic surreal painting style.
